title: Topple
description: Take turns stacking odd-shaped blocks on one wobbly tower. Drag, turn and flip your piece, then let go. Knock the tower over and you're out. Last one standing wins. Pass the phone around with friends or play against bots.

achievements.title: Against the Odds
achievements.description: Win a match against five bots.

achievements.title: Full Table
achievements.description: Finish a pass-and-play match with four or more people.
